name: @bakung-ui/bakung.css
description: HTML UI library pure CSS, lightweight, no javascript
author: Tria Warman @triawarman

scripts.build:lite: npx postcss css/_styles.css -o dist/bakung-lite.min.css --use postcss-import --use cssnano --use postcss-normalize-charset --no-map
scripts.build:liteUtils: cat css/_styles.css css/_utilities.css | npx postcss -o dist/bakung-lite-utils.min.css --use postcss-import --use cssnano --use postcss-normalize-charset --no-map
scripts.build:liteVars: npx postcss css/_variables.css -o dist/_variables.css --use postcss-import --no-map && npx postcss css/_styles.css -o dist/_styles.css --use postcss-import --no-map && cat dist/_variables.css dist/_styles.css | npx postcss -o dist/bakung-lite-vars.min.css --use cssnano --use postcss-normalize-charset --no-map && rm dist/_styles.css dist/_variables.css
scripts.build:bakung: npx postcss css/index.css -o dist/bakung.css --use postcss-import --use cssnano --use postcss-normalize-charset --env noMinimize --no-map && npx postcss dist/bakung.css -o dist/bakung.min.css --no-map
scripts.build: npm run build:lite && npm run build:liteUtils && npm run build:liteVars && npm run build:bakung
scripts.build:static: npx postcss dist/bakung-lite-utils.min.css -o dist/bakung-static-lite-utils.min.css --no-map --env buildStatic && npx postcss dist/bakung-lite.min.css -o dist/bakung-static-lite.min.css --no-map --env buildStatic && npx postcss dist/bakung.css -o dist/bakung-static.min.css --no-map --env buildStatic
